invariant: Every finding names baseline, detector, threshold, cut and expected error behavior.
A proposal is source/model/tool attributed, reviewable, non-authoritative and removable with deterministic fallback or explicit unavailability.
Every effect estimate is bound to a causal model, identification assumptions, estimand, estimator and data occurrence.
Conformance binds exact observed-log and normative-model editions plus algorithm and cost profile.
Corpus cut, document occurrence, segmentation/tokenization and method edition remain attached.
The estimand names population, variable, intervention/contrast where applicable and time scope before estimator selection.
Assignment edition, unit and eligibility precede exposure and remain replayable.
Feasibility is relative to the exact variable domains and constraint edition.
Forecast origin, horizon, information cut, target and uncertainty travel together.
A path preserves graph type, direction, edge meaning, temporal cut and algorithm semantics and never implies causality by shape alone.
Calibration, sampling/time base, operating conditions, detector edition and uncertainty remain attached.
Every event/object/case projection names source occurrences, correlation, ordering, state derivation and known omissions.
Model, scenario, parameter profile, seed policy, replication count and aggregation remain attached.
Status is interpreted only with exact model, parameters, tolerances, algorithm and termination evidence.
Geometry, CRS/datum, spatial support, accuracy and transformation lineage remain attached.
